book.name: 1 Bhakolinso
book.title: Baluwa ja kutumbula jaka Paulo kwa Bhakolinso

content: Njengalyaje ulenganesu wangu nepani, ngati nanatu monyengalela ulenganesu waka Kristo.
Kuyeka mmutu chikahi cha kundobha Chapanga
Nundumbalila kwa kubha mngomboka kwa kila lijambu, na kwa kukamulakila mabholu ghanakumpekihe.
Nambu mbala mmanyaje kubha mmutu waka kila mwanalomi nde Kristo, na mmutu waka kila mbomba nde mwanalomi, na mmutu waka Kristo nde Chapanga.
Bhela, kila mwanalomi, paandobha Chapanga au paatangaza Lilobhi laka Chapanga, koni ayekiki mmutu waki, jonihoju alipoha lihamu mmutu waki mweni.
Nambu kila mbomba paandobha Chapanga, au paatangaza Lilobhi laka Chapanga, panga na kuyeka mmutu waki, jonihoju alipoha lihamu mmutu waki mweni, kwa ndandi alengana na jola joamoghiki majunju ghaki.
Ngati mbomba ngaayeki mmutu waki, bhela impalika kupupa majunju ghaki. Nambu ngati anakubhi nde iyoni kwaka mbomba kupupa au kumogha majunju ghaki, bhela na impalika ayekaje mmutu waki.
Kwa ndandi chakaka ngacheimpalika mwanalomi kuyeka mmutu waki, maghambu jombi nde ulenganesu na ulumbalilu waka Chapanga. Nambu mbomba nde ulumbalilu waka ndomi waki.
Kwa ndandi mwanalomi ngacheakahumiki kwaka mbomba, nambu mbomba akahumiki kwaka mwanalomi.
Wala mwanalomi ngacheakabhombakiki kwa ndandi jaka mbomba, nambu mbomba akabhombakiki kwa ndandi jaka mwanalome.
Nde ndandi impalika mbomba ayekalyaje mmutu waki, jibya nginyulila ja lujiniku lolubhi panani jaki, na kwa ndandi ja bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga.
Hata bhela, palongi jaka Bambo, mbomba nga chindu panga mwanalome, na mwanalome nga chindu panga mbomba.
Kwa ndandi ngati mbomba akabhombakiki kubhokana na mwanalomi, bhelabhela mwanalomi najombi abhelakeka na mbomba, na hindu yokapi utumbulilu waki uhuma kwaka Chapanga.
Mtemulaje mabheti, bho, ipalika lelu kwaka mbomba kundobha Chapanga panga na kuyeka mmutu waki?
Bho, hata maumbili gha asili le ngacheghatubhola kubha nde iyoni kwaka mwanalomi kubha na majunju malachu?
Nambu kwaka mbomba kubha na majunju malachu nde chindu cha kunyambiha kwaki. Maghambu mbomba apekiwi majunju malachu nahuli kunhyeka.
Nambu anangati mundu apala kuleta ing'omu panani ja lijambu aleli, tepani ngachetubhi na ntetu ngati ghonihogho, wala makanisa ghaka Chapanga.
Chilebhi chaka Bambo
Bhela mu malaghalakilu ghaghajengalela, ngachenhweza kundumbalila, maghambu muhimangana nga kwa mambu ghambone, nambu kwa mambu gha liyaha.
Kutumbula kwa ghokape, nyowina kubha panketangana papamu mulikanisa papitalila ulekanganu pachilanda jinu. Nanatu kwa pandu pachokopi nhobhalela,
kwa ndandi ipalika pakubha na ulekanganu kwinu, nahuli kulangiha kubha jola joajetakaliwi na Chapanga amanyikanaje hotuhotu.
Bhela panketangana papamu muholakela kubha nkula Chilebhi chaka Bambo, nambu ngabhela.
Kwa ndandi pankula, kila jumu winu alongulela kutola chilebhi chaki panga kubhalendalela bhangi, ajoju atama na injala, na jongi alobhile.

Bho, ngachembi na nyumba ya kula na kunywelela? Bho, au mlijojoha likanisa laka Chapanga, na kubhapoha lihamu bhanga na chindu? Bho, muhobhalela numpwaghi kyane? Bho, nundumbalya kwa ndandi ja lijambu aleli? Ngabhela!
Kwa ndandi nepani nakajopalili kuhuma kwaka Bambo malaghalakilu ghala ghanakumpekihi mwehapa: Kubha Bambo Yesu ikilu jela paakabhohakiki, akatoliki libumunda,
akunchengwi Chapanga, akalihekiti, na kupwagha, “Jenjenu nde hyegha jango jejibhowakeka kwa ndandi jinu, mtenda anana kwa kungomboka nepani.”
Bhelabhela, pabhakajomwi kula, akatoliki chikombi cha divai, na kupwagha: “Chikombi achechi nde Lulaghilu Lwahenu mu mwahi wangu, mtendaje anana kila pamkunywa kwa kungomboka nepani.”
Kwa ndandi kila pankula libumunda na kuchinywelela chikombi achechi, mtangaza kupotela kwaka Bambo, mbaka paanahikaje.
Bhela, kila mundu joakula libumunda heli, au kuchinywelela chikombi hechi chaka Bambo kwangakupalika, anaabya alipatili mahoku panani ja hyegha na mwahi waka Bambo.
Bhela kila mundu impalika alilalukyaje mwene, mangane ja kula libumunda na kuchinywelela chikombi hechi.
Kwa ndandi mundu jokapi joakula na kunywa apalika amanya kwa chakaka kubha jeniheji nde hyegha jaka Bambo, nangakutenda bhenibhela aliletela utemulu panani jaki mwene.
Nde ndandi bhamaheli pachilanda jinu ngachebhabhi na makili na bhangi bhatamwa, na bhangi pachilanda jinu bhapotile.
Nambu ngati tukabhi tulimanyiki tabheti wichu, ngatukatemuliwi na Chapanga.
Nambu patutemuliwa, tukelabhukiwa na Bambo, nahuli ngatwitemuliwa papamu na ndema.
Bhela, bhalongu bhangu, panketangana kula Chilebhi chaka Bambo, kila jumu andendalyaje njaki.
Na ngati mundu anaabhi na injala, na akulaje kunyumba jaki, nahuli pamuhimangana papamu ngamwihika kutemuliwa. Na mambu ghangi ghaghahigalile, ananhika kulenganakela panihikaje.
